task: Bounded RGB-only synchronous visible-box localization baseline; not world-model or closed-loop completion

split.claim: Root-disjoint fresh initializations in known scene configurations; not unseen scenes or independent within-root frames
split.old_4state_8images: technical regression only, excluded from all fitting/scoring

collection.state0: native reset; then seven fixed motor waypoints; no post-reset teleports
collection.waypoint_execution: native robot.apply_action, eight stepSimulation calls, scene.step; same dynamics sequence as env.step, intermediate renders omitted
collection.technical_failure: retain all attempts, repair and deterministic retry allowed; preserve experimental conditions and cap unique samples

labels.front: visible exterior front slab and attached handle; exclude cavity-facing inner board, sides, floor
labels.fingers: unordered mechanical finger-plus-tip families, two objects
labels.any_unknown_drawer_pixel: entire front image-class unknown; no front box loss or scoring
labels.zero_visible_pixels: unknown visibility/occlusion/out-of-view cause; never object nonexistent; ignore whole image-class if any expected family has zero pixels
labels.box: visible xyxy half-open, no amodal inference
labels.negative_supervision: background patch centers in valid image-classes; report handle patches with no finger pixels/center as confusing hard-negative context
labels.absence_negative_claim: No certified whole-image absence labels expected; zero masks remain unknown. Presence/absence generalization is not established.

gates.sync_and_split_integrity: all planned samples and roots, flag-off RGB/depth equality, identical pre/post full snapshot, no shared root or identical full dual-camera pair across splits
gates.unknown_fraction: reported without relaxing labels; no extra fraction cutoff beyond actual positive/root coverage
gates.failure_action: data gate report; no fitting, no automatic data expansion

model.head: shared Linear384->64, SiLU, Linear64->15 (3 slots x [logit,dx,dy,w,h]); one front slot and two exchangeable finger slots
model.finger_slot_assignment: at each positive center patch sort GT by center x then y, assign slot1 then slot2; identical class, no inference ordering
model.input: RGB bilinear 448 resize; ImageNet mean/std; DINO patch feature channel mean/std from train only (std floor .05)
model.loss: valid image-class focal(alpha .25,gamma2), normalized per-image positive count; +5 smoothL1 +2 GIoU for positive boxes
model.decoder: all patch/slot candidates score>=.5, classwise greedy NMS IoU>.5; no local-peak suppression, no cardinality cap
model.metrics: greedy score-ordered one-to-one IoU>=.5 matching, TP FP FN precision recall F1 matched-TP mean IoU; unknown image-classes excluded; per class/camera/split and per root

training.development_use: report only after both final checkpoints frozen; no selection or tuning
training.final_holdout: predict once per seed after checkpoints frozen; predictions saved and hashed before opening final labels; one scoring invocation

visual_selection: predefined root indices 0 and 7 and state indices 0 and 4 per split/camera; not selected by score; display GT unknown explicitly
